summary.result: The results of FLAQUM application to Boryeong freshwater lake showed that the lake was in eutrophic condition.
summary.background: A freshwater lake water quality management system(FLAQUM) was developed to help regional manager for the water quality of a rural basin.
summary.method: The integrated user interface system FLAQUM written in Visual Basic, includes three subsystems such as a database management system, basin pollutant loads simulation model using SWMM model and freshwater lake water quality simulation model using WASP5 model.
